overview.summary: The site has a functional structure but is missing several critical SEO and performance optimizations. Quick wins include adding meta descriptions, fixing missing alt text, and improving mobile responsiveness. Addressing these issues could significantly boost organic traffic and conversion rates.

issues: Missing meta description on homepage
No H1 tag found on 3 pages
6 images are missing alt text
Duplicate title tags detected across product pages
No canonical tags set
recommendations: Add a unique meta description (under 160 characters) to every page
Ensure each page has exactly one H1 tag that includes the primary keyword
Add descriptive alt text to all images for accessibility and image SEO
Use unique, descriptive title tags per page to avoid duplicate content issues
Add canonical tags to prevent search engines from indexing duplicate URLs

issues: 3 large inline JavaScript blocks detected (>50KB each)
Images are not using lazy loading
No viewport meta tag found
Render-blocking CSS found in <head>
No compression (gzip/brotli) detected on assets
recommendations: Move inline scripts to external files and defer or async load them
Add loading='lazy' attribute to all below-the-fold images
Add <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'> for mobile support
Move non-critical CSS to the bottom of the page or use media queries
Enable gzip or brotli compression on your server to reduce asset sizes

issues: No viewport meta tag — site is not mobile friendly
Call-to-action buttons are too small (under 44px touch target)
Low color contrast on footer text (ratio: 2.8:1, minimum is 4.5:1)
No skip navigation link for keyboard users
Form fields missing visible labels
recommendations: Add a viewport meta tag immediately to enable proper mobile rendering
Increase all CTA button sizes to a minimum of 44x44px for touch accessibility
Increase footer text color contrast to at least 4.5:1 for WCAG AA compliance
Add a 'Skip to main content' link at the top of the page for keyboard navigation
Add visible <label> elements to all form inputs for usability and accessibility

issues: Homepage has fewer than 300 words — thin content
No blog or resources section found
Product descriptions are generic and duplicated across variants
No customer testimonials or trust signals visible
Missing FAQ section that could capture long-tail keywords
recommendations: Expand homepage copy to at least 500 words with clear value propositions
Start a blog targeting informational keywords relevant to your products
Write unique, detailed product descriptions for each variant
Add a testimonials section with real customer reviews to build trust
Create an FAQ page to answer common questions and capture long-tail search traffic

quickWins: Add meta descriptions to all pages — takes under 30 minutes and directly improves click-through rates from search results
Fix missing alt text on 6 images — improves accessibility compliance and image search visibility immediately
Add the viewport meta tag — instantly makes the site mobile-friendly and prevents Google mobile ranking penalties
